plan.title: Psoriasis lesional vs control skin: limma-trend DE + GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: The input is a gene-level Salmon TPM table (12,000 genes x 12 samples; /eval-full-32-with-tpm-input-n6-1/data/inputs/abundance/tpm.csv) with a 12 x 2 sample table (metadata.csv) giving 6 psoriasis lesional and 6 control skin samples, unpaired, single batch. No raw counts and no Salmon quantification directories were delivered, which fixes the statistical method: count models (DESeq2, edgeR, voom) assume integer counts with negative-binomial mean-variance behaviour and are invalid on TPM, so differential expression runs as limma on log2(TPM+1) with eBayes(trend=TRUE, robust=TRUE). No count-based between-sample normalization (TMM, size factors) is applied — TPM already carries within-sample length and depth scaling, and the log transform is the only transform. The tximport length-offset route normally recommended for Salmon input cannot be taken because the quantification directories are absent; the plan records that as a limitation rather than pretending to it, and the report must state that isoform-usage shifts can therefore masquerade as gene-level changes. T1S1 does sample-structure QC on the log matrix (PCA/MDS on the 500 most variable genes, sample-distance heatmap, detected genes per sample) so a sample that does not sit with its condition group is named before the model. T1S2 filters to genes at >=1 TPM in at least 6 samples (the smallest group size), fits ~condition with control set explicitly as the reference level, tests the lesional-vs-control contrast, and selects by BH-adjusted p-value; any effect-size floor is tested inside the model with treat() rather than filtered post hoc. T2S1 takes the full ranked list of tested genes into fgsea against human MSigDB hallmark, with GO Biological Process as the second collection (Reactome C2 is not staged here). The ranking statistic is the disputed choice of R-0108: this plan uses the limma moderated t-statistic, the direct analogue of the DESeq2 Wald statistic for a limma fit (signed, scaled by the moderated standard error), and the report states it. T1S3 assembles the report with the reproducibility record, DE counts, leading-edge genes per significant set, and the TPM-input caveats. Power is modest: 6 vs 6 over 12,000 quantified genes. Psoriasis lesional skin is a large-effect contrast, so a substantial DE list is expected, but any gene near the significance boundary is provisional.
